source: Common checks for web pages and web apps (general testing practice). Descriptions are ours.

heuristics.name: Broken links
heuristics.description: Links and buttons that lead nowhere, to an error page or to the wrong place are easy to miss.
heuristics.apply: Follow each link and navigation control and check it lands on the page its label promises.

heuristics.name: Deep link and reload
heuristics.description: A page opened directly by URL, or reloaded, may lose state the app kept in memory.
heuristics.apply: Copy a page's URL, open it in a new tab and reload it, then compare with reaching it by clicking.

heuristics.name: Back button
heuristics.description: The browser's back button can resubmit forms, show stale data or break single-page apps.
heuristics.apply: After each navigation and each form submission, press back and then forward.

heuristics.name: Session expiry
heuristics.description: When a session ends, the next action should ask to log in again without losing the user's work silently.
heuristics.apply: Log in, wait for the session to expire or log out in another tab, then try to act.

heuristics.name: Several tabs
heuristics.description: The same app open in two tabs can get out of step, for example after logging out in one.
heuristics.apply: Open the app in two tabs, change something or log out in one, and use the other.

heuristics.name: Search edges
heuristics.description: Search handles empty queries, no results, many results and special characters in different ways.
heuristics.apply: Search for nothing, for something that can't exist, for a very common word and for text with symbols.

heuristics.name: Paging edges
heuristics.description: The first page, the last page and changing the page size are where paging usually breaks.
heuristics.apply: Go to the first and last page, change the page size on a later page, and check no items repeat or go missing.

heuristics.name: Sort and filter
heuristics.description: Sorting and filtering together, or with paging, can drop or repeat items.
heuristics.apply: Sort, filter and page through the same list in different orders and compare the items you see.

heuristics.name: Cart totals
heuristics.description: A cart's total should always equal its items times their prices, plus the stated extras.
heuristics.apply: Add, change and remove items, and recompute the total by hand after each step.

heuristics.name: Login variants
heuristics.description: Login has many paths: wrong password, unknown user, empty fields, different letter case, remember me.
heuristics.apply: Try each variant with a test account and check the messages are clear and that remember me behaves as stated.

heuristics.name: Registration rules
heuristics.description: Sign-up forms enforce rules (unique email, password rules, required fields) that may be applied inconsistently.
heuristics.apply: Register with a duplicate email, weak and strong passwords, and each required field missing.

heuristics.name: Password reset flow
heuristics.description: A reset flow should work end to end, with clear messages at each step.
heuristics.apply: Request a reset for a test account and follow it through, checking each message and the final login.

heuristics.name: Email formats
heuristics.description: Valid email addresses come in more shapes than most validators accept.
heuristics.apply: Try addresses with a plus sign, subdomains, capitals, a long local part and an obviously invalid one.

heuristics.name: Notification timing
heuristics.description: Toasts and banners that disappear quickly can hide important information or cover other controls.
heuristics.apply: Trigger each notification and check it can be read in time and doesn't block anything underneath.

heuristics.name: Overlays that block
heuristics.description: Cookie notices, banners and menus can cover controls and make them unusable.
heuristics.apply: With each overlay open, check the controls under it, and check each overlay can be closed.

heuristics.name: Language switch
heuristics.description: Switching language should translate everything and keep the user's place and data.
heuristics.apply: Change the language mid-task and check labels, messages, formats and entered data.

heuristics.name: Responsive layout
heuristics.description: Layouts change at different widths, and controls can overlap or disappear.
heuristics.apply: Resize the window from wide to phone width and check every control stays visible and usable.

heuristics.name: Console and network errors
heuristics.description: A page shouldn't throw uncaught script errors, or fail its own requests, while it's used normally. Each one means something on the page didn't work as it was built to, even when the page hides it.
heuristics.apply: Watch the console and network log while using each page, and note errors and failed requests.
